product.name: Interactive Learning Platform
product.description: A platform that converts videos, documents, and audio into interactive learning experiences with features like summaries, quizzes, flashcards, and AI chat support.

product.name: Educator Tools
product.description: Tools for educators to create interactive lessons with assessments, track student progress, and provide personalized feedback using analytics.

product.name: Enterprise Learning Platform
product.description: A platform for organizations to convert internal content into interactive training modules with assessments, certification tracking, and analytics.
